name: farmexit
description: FarmExit: Next.js frontend (web/) and NestJS API (api/). Each app keeps its own package-lock.

scripts.setup: npm install && npm --prefix web ci && npm --prefix api ci
scripts.build: npm run build:web && npm run build:api
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck:web && npm run typecheck:api
scripts.lint: npm run lint:web && npm run lint:api
scripts.format:check: npm --prefix web run format:check && npm --prefix api run format:check
scripts.test: npm run test:api && npm run test:api:e2e && npm run test:web
